items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The president of the Hot Club whose name was Conrad Matiossek, played trumpet and he is the only one that I remember.

ctx.x: At the Ace of Clubs, there was a giant size Arab who was the doorman and he spoke very good English. We became quite friendly that night. And as I liked a little taste of gage now and then, and was also aware that I was in a country where I could get some good stuff, I hit on this fellow and he was more than happy to get me a supply. The next night he had a nice package for me and some of the other musicians who also liked a taste now and then were my guests.

May the 24th, we did another concert at the Municipal Theatre in Casa and attraction at the Club where I played also the 25th. The 26th I went to Meknes to play with an orchestra composed of French amateur musicians who were residing in Morocco and some of them may have been born there. The president of the Hot Club whose name was Conrad Matiossek, played trumpet and he is the only one that I remember. I was supposed to come back to Paris from Casablanca the 27th of May but the Air France company had a strike that day and I was obliged to stay in Casa. There was a Martinque trumpet player named Eddie Laspar whom I had known in Paris who was co-director of a club in Casa called Cabane Cubaine. Eddie asked if I would like to do a few numbers in his place that night and I accepted as I had nothing else to do.
